meta.description: Webhook-triggered guard for untrusted log/error payloads (e.g. forwarded from Sentry or an error-tracking webhook). Persists the payload, runs `local81 scan --json` (Merkle integrity + injection scanning) on the control node, and branches: high-severity injection is quarantined and alerted; clean payloads are sanitized and forwarded. The point: nothing reaches a downstream AI agent / MCP context until it has passed Local-81 Log Guard. Requires `local81` on PATH on the control node; optionally set LOCAL81_DIR and the ALERT_URL / FORWARD_URL credentials.

parameters.command: cd ${LOCAL81_DIR:-/srv/local81} && local81 scan "{{ $node["Persist payload"].json["file"] }}" --sanitize-to "{{ $node["Persist payload"].json["dir"] }}/sanitized" --quiet --fail-on never && cat "{{ $node["Persist payload"].json["dir"] }}/sanitized/incoming.log"

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "injection_detected", action: "quarantined", report: $node["Log Guard scan"].json["stdout"] }) }}
